statements.type: Precautions re: Pregnant or Nursing or Prescription Medications
statements.notes: Do not use if you are pregnant or nursing. Do not take this product before first consulting a licensed, qualified, health care professional if you are taking any other dietary supplement, prescription drug or over-the-counter medication; or if, you suspect you have or have been treated for, diagnosed with or have a family history of, any medical condition.

Discontinue use 2 weeks prior to surgery. Immediately discontinue use and contact a medical doctor if you experience any adverse reaction to this product. Do not use if the safety seal is broken or missing.
Store in a cool dry place.
Keep out of reach of children.
